hook: Your Earth once rose above the Moon, and someone photographed it.
title: Your Whole Earth Rising Over the Moon
description:
In December 1968, Apollo 8 astronaut Bill Anders took the photo known as Earthrise. It shows our blue Earth above the grey lunar surface, seen from orbit around the Moon. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Apollo8 #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Is this your favourite space photo? Yes or no
